N0: control, p = 0: the raw score (centred rank).

N1: Numerai partial neutralisation, p = 0.5: s = centred rank of score over names with score and eligibility at t; E = [1, z(beta_t), z(log ADV_t), z(vol60_t), sector dummies (11 GICS sectors by the typed 2-digit code industry_code[:2], plus one 'no sector' group)]; s -= 0.5 * E @ pinv(E) @ s; then re-rank. z = cross-sectional standardisation over the same names each week, no winsorisation. ADV_t = mean FINRA Reg SHO total share volume over sessions t-19..t (>= 10 sessions), log; vol60_t = sd of D['r'] over t-59..t (>= 40 sessions); missing exposure -> cross-sectional mean (z = 0).
N2w: within-sector ranks: percentile rank of the score within its sector group ('no sector' is a group) at t, centred. Scored on the full period, descriptive.

N2rule: Ehsani-Harvey-Li ex-ante rule on 2013-2016 only: rank-weighted book w = centred rank (sides 0.5), w_across = sector mean of w (per name), w_within = w - w_across; weekly gross returns w.y5; neutralise iff SR(across)/SR(within) < corr(across, within). If yes N2rule = N2w, else N2rule = N0. Reported: the decision, 2017-2019 result of applying it vs N0, full-period both choices. Decile-book decomposition reported descriptively only.

Metrics: weekly IC mean/sd/t; harness.decile_net (5 bp) net %/yr, net Sharpe, max drawdown; M1 band book (band 0.1, M1 simulate, first week dropped); paired weekly IC and net differences vs N0, Newey-West t (4 lags); 2013-16 vs 2017-19 split. Best per signal = highest decile net Sharpe with max drawdown no worse than N0's.

Decile net Sharpe rises for trees (0.15->0.32) and MASTER (-0.26->-0.11), not significant (NW t 0.31, 0.93), all in 2013-16 (2017-19 diffs -0.08, +0.12 %/yr); band book not improved; IPCA hurt by N1 (-2.7 %/yr, t -1.59). Neutralisation is a risk lever, not a net-return lever on these signals. Development results, not OOS; survivorship gap; current GICS applied to the past.
